title: Survival Parkour Wand
description: Craftable Parkour Wand that starts a forward-flowing, survival-legal parkour course with timer, skip bonuses, particles, and chat stats.
body:
SPW (Fabric 1.20.1) adds a simple, replayable parkour mini-game to survival. Use the Parkour Wand to launch ~20 blocks up and start a procedurally generated path that always remains within survival-possible jump ranges (≤4 blocks horizontally, ±1 vertically). Land on each block to extend the path; skip exactly one block to earn a double extension. Falling ends the run and prints your time, blocks cleared, and skips in chat. Each new platform appears with a short particle flourish.

Features

Craftable Parkour Wand (see recipe screenshot below).
Direction-locked path generation (no backward steps) with a small lateral/vertical variation.
Always keeps a small buffer of blocks ahead so jumps feel fair.
Skip mechanic: landing two ahead spawns two new blocks.
Particles on each new platform; optional sound hook ready.
Cleanup of placed blocks when the run ends.

How to Play

Craft the Parkour Wand.

Right-click to start a run (you’ll be lifted and the first path appears).

Keep landing on platforms; don’t fall!

Requirements

Minecraft 1.20.1, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Java 17.
Works in singleplayer and servers (install on both sides for models/textures).
